results.description:
A fake dating ice hockey romance to fall in love with! Perfect for fans of Heated Rivalry, Rachel Reid and Chelsea Curto 🏒 🥅 💕

One wild night in Vegas. One accidental marriage. One very real problem… falling in love. 🏒💍

When Sienna Jamieson's partner – in life and work – decides to trade her in for a younger, slinkier model, she’s at risk of losing everything… and being deported. That’s how she comes to be crying on the shoulder of her manchild client and ice hockey star, Jax Harris, on a Las Vegas chapel crawl with him and his New York Dragons teammates.

Jax Harris has been called many things – hockey sensation, superstar, playboy, irresponsible, irresistible, and most likely to spend time in the sin bin. But waking up in his Las Vegas suite with his PR in his bed and a jelly ring on her wedding finger is the first time he’s been called an accidental husband.

Sienna needs their fake relationship to last just long enough to get her life – and visa – back on track. And dating Sienna seems to be having a positive impact on Jax’s reputation on and off the ice.

All they need to do is stick to the game plan. But one of them is about to have a shift change. Can their marriage of convenience become something more?

TROPES:

Sports romance
Hockey romance
Fake dating
Marriage of convenience
Workplace romance
Opposites attract
Grumpy x sunshine
Haters to friends to lovers
Found family
